bug_semantics: Fission's tenant-facing Environment and Function validation and its executor merge defense used a fixed six-entry denylist for securityContext.capabilities.add. SYS_TIME was not listed, so a tenant with Function/Environment CRUD could request SYS_TIME in a PodSpec container or initContainer (and, after the same policy was reused, a bare Runtime/Builder Container), pass admission, survive merge sanitization, and run with CAP_SYS_TIME. Without a restrictive cluster PSA policy, clock_settime(CLOCK_REALTIME) can then rewrite the node-wide, non-time-namespaced real-time clock and disrupt every co-tenant's certificate windows, leases, token expiry, scheduling, and time-series integrity. The denylist also could not remove OCI-runtime default capabilities; that separate structural concern was explicitly not fully repaired by this advisory's final fix.
flaw_origin: This was an incomplete security remediation. Mainline squash e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64 introduced ValidatePodSpecSafety with dangerousCapabilities limited to SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_MODULE, DAC_READ_SEARCH, and DAC_OVERRIDE, while its own tests intentionally allowed other capabilities such as CHOWN. The same atomic squash added a merge-layer dangerousMergeContainerCapabilities list with the identical six entries. PR #3391 decomposition shows the admission denylist originated in member 2db76f65dbfe4f657b4a4efb506ed63b24623e92 and the matching merge-layer denylist in member c8a58b7a88448f55bdf3ff01e149e82370fcfd7d, but those PR-only members were never the released/mainline atomic change; e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64 is the counted BIC.

evidence: The first-party advisory GHSA-qf5v-m7p4-95rp identifies <=1.24.0 as affected, 1.25.0 as first patched, PR #3465, and commit https://github.com/fission/fission/commit/2569b42bfadbcb7d78b55a00a60f77937e522699. In the validated clone, git diff 8fa799417c77ce8a0189d9858bfe11ece29b84a6 e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64 shows pkg/apis/core/v1/podspec_safety.go created with dangerousCapabilities containing exactly SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_MODULE, DAC_READ_SEARCH, and DAC_OVERRIDE; the same diff shows pkg/executor/util/merge.go adding dangerousMergeContainerCapabilities with the same six values and filtering only listed values. SYS_TIME is absent from both. git log -S'dangerousCapabilities' and -S'dangerousMergeContainerCapabilities', plus git log -L on both map definitions, identify e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64 as the mainline introduction and 2569b42bfadbcb7d78b55a00a60f77937e522699 as their replacement. Immediate-parent tree verification is direct: git cat-file -e 8fa799417c77ce8a0189d9858bfe11ece29b84a6:pkg/apis/core/v1/podspec_safety.go fails because the file is absent, and the parent-to-BIC merge.go diff adds the merge sanitizer/map. GitHub's PR #3391 commits API reconstructs the squash: 2db76f65dbfe4f657b4a4efb506ed63b24623e92 creates the six-entry admission map and c8a58b7a88448f55bdf3ff01e149e82370fcfd7d adds the identical merge map; neither is substituted for the released first-parent atomic BIC. Later commit 695d3e97e3a20463ab7c8c081843e69e65e952e5 only refactors the existing map into ValidateContainerSafety and extends it to bare Runtime/Builder Container surfaces, and is an ancestor of v1.24.0. Version checks: e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64 is an ancestor of v1.24.0 (tag commit ce617120c41b9e4a51d577f81b441238264e88fd) but not v1.23.0; 2569b42bfadbcb7d78b55a00a60f77937e522699 is not an ancestor of v1.24.0 and is an ancestor of v1.25.0 (tag commit ae970aaa9bc76ec93d748bdaf03fd7523b6b6a62). Thus this particular incomplete-denylist mechanism shipped in v1.24.0; earlier versions in the advisory's broad <=1.24.0 range predate this remediation and had the wider pre-validator condition. The fix diff at 2569b42bfadbcb7d78b55a00a60f77937e522699 replaces both denylist maps with allowlists containing only NET_BIND_SERVICE, so explicit SYS_TIME is rejected at admission and removed at merge. The final squash intentionally rolls back its attempted forced drop:[ALL], matching the advisory's stated out-of-scope OCI-default-capability concern.
reasoning: The vulnerable lifecycle starts with PR #3391's released squash e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64, an attempted repair for earlier PodSpec privilege-injection advisories. Its policy decision was to preserve tenant customization by rejecting only six named capabilities. That negative list necessarily treats every omitted capability as allowed; specifically, SYS_TIME passes ValidatePodSpecSafety and the later standalone ValidateContainerSafety. The defense-in-depth sanitizer repeats the same error, retaining any add entry not in its six-name map. A tenant-controlled SYS_TIME therefore reaches the produced pod and enables the advisory's demonstrated shared-node wall-clock attack when restrictive PSA is absent. The immediate parent lacks the new validator file and lacks the merge capability sanitizer, and history searches locate no earlier mainline copy, so e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64 is the smallest released atomic BIC. The squash was decomposed to the two causal PR members for provenance, but the unreleased member commits are not substituted for the mainline BIC. Commit 695d3e97e3a20463ab7c8c081843e69e65e952e5 widened use of the already-flawed policy and did not originate it. Fix 2569b42bfadbcb7d78b55a00a60f77937e522699 changes both enforcement layers to the positive PSA-restricted allowlist {NET_BIND_SERVICE}, closing explicit CAP_SYS_TIME injection at the v1.25.0 boundary. Finally, the BIC commit object itself contains the exact Claude Co-Authored-By trailer, and that BIC first writes the causally incomplete policy, satisfying AI_ROOT_CAUSE rather than AI_CODE_FLAWED or NOT_AI.
